scope: Sixteen calm grass ground material source candidates; no runtime integration.

variants.title: 01 · Sehr ruhig · Neutrales Waldgrün
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE new opaque square seamless GRASS GROUND MATERIAL SOURCE for Fragdachse, a dark woodland 2D overhead game.
This is a dark woodland game material. Do NOT make a scene, UI, trees, rocks, broadleaf plants, flowers, shadows or fog. The user's current grass floor looks too busy; this new texture must create a significantly CALMER resting background beneath separately placed vegetation sprites.
Camera and layout: exact vertical 90-degree orthographic top view, all grass flush with the ground. Edge-to-edge opaque material, no horizon, perspective, central object, individual isolated tuft, transparency, borders or text. Seamlessly tileable in both directions, even values at all edges, no mirrored or repeated pattern.
Physical coverage: the whole image represents 8 by 8 METRES, later reduced to 256 by 256 WORLD pixels (32 world px per metre). It is a broad ground area, not a macro photograph. Short grass blades about 8–20 cm long (2.5–6 game px), loose small groupings 20–40 cm across. No metre-size leaves or bulky tussocks.
STYLE: near-realistic but distinctly artist-painted 2D fantasy-game material, slightly stylized and selectively detailed. Natural grassy forms simplified into soft-edged overlapping painted planes and a limited number of elegant tapered blade marks. Think calm hand-painted terrain albedo, NOT photorealistic grass, scan, photo collage, photogrammetry or procedurally noisy texture. Preserve purposeful blade shapes without granular microtexture.
CRUCIAL CALMNESS: match blade light and dark values closely to surrounding grass. Avoid thousands of tiny bright scratch marks and black interstices. No high-contrast straw, no grain blanket, no stippling, no speckling, no sharpened edges, no microdots. No camouflage pattern of dark and light blobs. Broader colour variation must be very gentle and barely noticeable, without a visible dominant patch or wavy cloud pattern. The material should read as one connected grassy surface; individual painted blades emerge quietly on closer inspection. It must NOT be a blurred photograph, blank green fill, felt, moss, lichen, artificial lawn, cauliflower clumps or dense hay.
Light: soft even diffuse neutral illumination, matte and flat, no cast shadows, no heavy ambient occlusion, no vignette or bright centre. Keep a narrow readable muted mid-dark value band, not near-black. No deep shadow wells.
Content: only short woodland grass, with tiny subdued base gaps tinted near the grass hue. Absolutely no flowers, stones, scattered brown leaves, twigs, roots, mushrooms, tall plants, decorative ferns or isolated surface objects. No baked environment lighting or mist.

Colour direction: Neutral muted woodland green: base around #344336 to #404d3d, quiet highlights around #4b5847. Restrained natural green, balanced warm/cool, no yellow dominance. Keep all accents within this family.
Detail direction: Very quiet low-detail base. Short interwoven grass is suggested mostly by close-valued overlapping softly painted grassy planes. Only a few small coherent fans carry explicitly painted tapered blades, distributed irregularly and inconspicuously; at least 75 percent of the area stays visually quiet. No evenly spaced stamps and no visible empty green islands. Gentle real grassy texture, not cloud blur. This is the calmest member of the set.
Highest priority: strictly GRASS ONLY, no clover, fern leaflets, rosette weeds or small oval leaves. Every explicit blade is a short narrow tapering ribbon; never a leafy branching stalk. Top-down horizontal blade flow without upright side-view bouquets.
CALMEST OVERRIDE: This texture must be unusually quiet: about 90 percent understated close-valued short grassy undergrowth, with ONLY 12–18 small loose groups of 3–5 explicitly readable blades across the ENTIRE 8-metre-square image, and only barely suggested low-contrast blades elsewhere. Most of the surface is a connected softly painted short-grass mat, without separate dark/light clumps. Smoothly simplified grassy structure, neither blur nor mottled noise. Details should have very subtle value differences, only 5–9 RGB levels brighter than the nearby base. No hundreds of bright little tufts. Aim for a quiet unintrusive field of dark forest green underneath sparse actual grass marks.
